acceptance_criteria.text: PRECONDITION: before any code change, refresh .loop/baseline/ by capturing `invespend --help` and every `invespend <sub> --help` from the unmodified base commit (2eee10c) and record the SHA; all CLI-surface comparisons use this baseline.
acceptance_criteria.verify: Baseline files exist for top + all current subcommands with recorded base SHA; regenerating at the base SHA is byte-identical; refresh precedes first source diff.

acceptance_criteria.text: Test-suite floor: at least 330 pre-existing tests pass (measured at HEAD 2eee10c via `uv run pytest -q` -> '330 passed', then `git checkout uv.lock`) plus all new tests; 0 failures, 0 errors. CLAUDE.md '62' is stale.
acceptance_criteria.verify: `uv run pytest -q` reports >=330 passed + new tests, 0 failed, 0 errors; `git checkout uv.lock` run afterwards and `git status` shows uv.lock unmodified.

acceptance_criteria.text: Dry-run is the default and the live gate is retained unchanged: live requires explicit live_enabled() (flag AND payment-capable credential); in dry-run no write endpoint (paymultiple/_post) is called and the result is recorded 'dry-run'. No default (code, .env.example, workflow) turns live on.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: default -> client write mock not_called, outcome 'executed:dry-run'; flag without cred -> stays dry-run; both -> mocked write invoked and live enablement audited. grep workflow/.env.example: live flag absent or false.

acceptance_criteria.text: Trigger grammar: body contains the token 'pay' followed by exactly 3 digits (case-insensitive, word-bounded, e.g. 'pay 123' / 'pay123'); digits-only (letters not accepted) unless human changes Q5. No trigger -> message ignored (no pending, no reply, audit 'ignored'). 'pay' with 2 or 4 digits -> ignored/parked, not guessed.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest parametrised: 'pay 123','Pay123' trigger; 'pay abc','pay 12','pay 1234','payment 123','repay 123' do not; no-trigger mail creates no state and sends no email.

acceptance_criteria.text: The 3 digits select the SOURCE account by exact match on last-3 of the user's real accounts (get_accounts). Zero or >1 matching accounts (ambiguity across profiles/accounts) -> fail closed (parked, notify, no execute). Last-3 is never an authorization factor.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: unique match resolves sourceAccountId bound into approval; 0 matches and 2 matches across profiles -> parked, execute not_called.

acceptance_criteria.text: PRIMARY CONTROL sender authentication: a message is processed only if (a) the OUTER From address is on a configured allowlist AND (b) Authentication-Results from the receiving mail host shows dkim=pass and spf=pass aligned with that From domain. Reply-To is never used for identity or routing. Missing/failed/absent headers -> fail closed (ignored+audited).
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: allowlisted From + dkim/spf pass -> processed; spoofed From (fail/none), allowlisted display-name with foreign address, Reply-To set to allowlisted address with foreign From, missing Authentication-Results -> not processed, no state, audit reason.

acceptance_criteria.text: Forwarded mail: authentication is applied to the OUTER (forwarding) sender only; From/headers/addresses inside the forwarded body or message/rfc822 attachment are never trusted for identity. Content of the forward is searched for payment data but cannot satisfy sender auth.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: forward by allowlisted+authenticated user with inner message from stranger -> processed; forward by non-allowlisted outer sender with inner allowlisted From -> rejected.

acceptance_criteria.text: Search scope: for a triggered message the pipeline searches reply and forward body, quoted text, and pdf/xlsx/csv attachments for payment amount/currency/payee (existing extraction reused). Conflicting figures (two amounts, two payees, currency mismatch, corrupt attachment) -> parked, never executed. Image OCR stays out of scope (graceful skip).
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest fixtures: body, quoted, forwarded, pdf, xlsx, csv each yield the expected candidate; conflicting figures across body vs attachment -> 'parked'; image-only -> skipped, no pending.

acceptance_criteria.text: Beneficiary resolution is exact and registered-only: payee resolves only to an exact existing beneficiaryId from the account's registered beneficiaries; a parsed account number is never paid directly; fuzzy/partial match never auto-resolves.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: exact match -> candidate with registered beneficiaryId; near-miss/ambiguous/no match -> not resolved; value passed to execute is the registered id.

acceptance_criteria.text: Unregistered payee (Q1, resolved): notify the user by email that the payee must be added in Investec Online/app, with details (name, bank, account number, branch code, reference, email/cell if present) in the Investec mobile-app field order (order per Q6). The system NEVER calls any beneficiary-creating endpoint and no payment is scheduled for it.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: unregistered payee -> exactly one notification email with fields in the configured order; no create-beneficiary call exists (grep src for beneficiar creation endpoints finds none); client write mock not_called; no pending execute_after.

acceptance_criteria.text: Notification emails mask or minimise data: full account number appears only in the unregistered-payee paste-details email to the verified user (necessary for the purpose), never in logs/audit/state/other emails.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: captured logs, audit rows, stored state and summary/reminder emails contain no full account number; paste-details email goes only to the authenticated allowlisted sender.

acceptance_criteria.text: 24h hold implemented app-side (the Investec API has no scheduled/delayed payment): on accepting a valid instruction a pending record is persisted with execute_after = accepted_at + 24h (configurable, default 24h) and expires_at; nothing is sent to paymultiple at acceptance.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest with injected clock: at t0 record has execute_after=t0+24h, write mock not_called; run at t0+23h59m -> not executed; at t0+24h -> eligible.

acceptance_criteria.text: On acceptance a summary email is sent immediately (source last-3, payee name, amount, execute_after, how to cancel) and a reminder is sent before execution (default ~1h before; once only).
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: acceptance -> one summary email; run in reminder window -> one reminder; rerun -> no duplicate reminder; emails contain no token secret or full account number.

acceptance_criteria.text: Cancel by reply: an authenticated (F6) reply from the allowlisted sender with a cancel keyword referencing the pending payment cancels it; cancel is atomic versus execute (compare-and-set on status in one DB transaction) so exactly one of cancel/execute wins, never both.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: cancel before execute_after -> status cancelled, never executed; concurrent cancel vs execute (two threads/transactions against test DB or store fake with CAS) -> exactly one winner; unauthenticated cancel ignored.

acceptance_criteria.text: At execution time (>= execute_after) re-verify: beneficiary still registered and unchanged, source account still resolves uniquely, sufficient available balance, per-payment and daily caps; any failure -> parked + notified, not executed. Obtain a fresh OAuth token for the payment call (never reuse a token cached from acceptance).
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: beneficiary removed/changed, balance short, cap now exceeded each -> parked, write mock not_called; token fetch occurs at execution (client token mock call count incremented after the hold).

acceptance_criteria.text: Expiry window: a pending payment not executed within a configured window after execute_after (default 24h; Q2) is expired and notified rather than executed late; behaviour after the hold follows Q2 proposal (auto-pay unless cancelled, within expiry window).
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: now > execute_after+expiry -> status expired, write mock not_called, one notification; within window -> executes.

acceptance_criteria.text: Idempotency: the paymultiple POST is NEVER automatically retried (no retry/backoff on the write); a 200 response whose body carries ErrorMessage or AuthorisationRequired (or any non-success item status) is treated as FAILURE. Unknown outcome (timeout) -> marked 'unknown/needs_review', notified, never re-sent automatically. Same payment cannot execute twice.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: write mock raising timeout -> call_count==1, status needs_review; 200 {ErrorMessage:...} and AuthorisationRequired -> status failed, not 'executed'; re-run cycle -> call_count still 1; urllib3/requests retry adapter absent on the write path.

acceptance_criteria.text: Caps fail closed: per-payment cap and persisted daily aggregate cap are enforced pre-execution (and re-checked at execution, F15); an unset cap, 0, negative or unparsable value means NO payment allowed. Daily total survives restart.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: cap unset/0/'abc' -> blocked; over per-payment -> blocked; aggregate pushing over daily -> blocked; reloaded store retains total; write mock not_called when blocked.

acceptance_criteria.text: Append-only audit trail records every step (received, auth result, ignored, parked, accepted, reminder, cancel, execute, fail, expire) with timestamps; never contains full account numbers, PAN, tokens, signing secret or other PII beyond hashed message id and last-3.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: full lifecycle -> ordered entries, none mutated/deleted; scan of audit text finds no 9+ digit run, no secret, no email body.

acceptance_criteria.text: Defect fix #1 (verify first): CLI approve-payments never passes approval_recipients to run_approval_cycle (cli.py ~L307), so pending approval/summary emails are never sent in production. Reproduce with a failing test, then fix so summary/notification recipients come from config (the authenticated allowlisted user), without changing existing flags' meaning.
acceptance_criteria.verify: A new test fails at base 2eee10c and passes after fix: CLI cycle with a pending item invokes smtp send to the configured recipient; existing approve-payments --help unchanged unless Q-approved additive flag.

acceptance_criteria.text: Defect fix #2 (verify first): dedup key includes the inbound Message-ID, so a reply (new Message-ID) yields a different key and token/cancel replies are rejected or create duplicates. Reproduce with a failing test, then key cancel/approval matching on the pending record's stable id/nonce (carried in Subject/References/In-Reply-To), not the reply's Message-ID. Dedup of the same original email remains.
acceptance_criteria.verify: New test fails at base and passes after: original mail then reply with different Message-ID matches the same pending; same original mail twice -> one pending; different payments -> different keys.

acceptance_criteria.text: Frozen behaviour: ingest, report, statements, backfill-hashes, backup, init-db and beneficiary-matching outputs are unchanged; no change to existing CLI flags/help; any new CLI surface is additive only and approved.
acceptance_criteria.verify: Refreshed baseline --help byte-identical for all pre-existing subcommands; existing ingest/report/statement/beneficiary tests unmodified and green; git diff shows no edits to ingest/report/statements modules' logic.

acceptance_criteria.text: Schema: only additive migrations (next free prefix 0013+), state stored in Postgres via the existing pg_store pattern, RLS enabled with deny_all policies for new tables (matching 0010/0011); no edits to existing migrations, tables or views.
acceptance_criteria.verify: git diff -- db/migrations shows only new files; migrations apply in numeric order on a scratch DB; new tables have ROW LEVEL SECURITY and deny_all policy; migration-order test green; views definitions unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.text: No secrets committed: .env stays git-ignored; credentials, signing secret, IMAP/SMTP creds and Investec keys come from env/Actions secrets only and never appear in code, logs, emails, audit or workflow files.
acceptance_criteria.verify: git check-ignore .env succeeds; grep of tracked files/diff for key patterns finds none; test asserts secrets absent from logs, emails, audit.

acceptance_criteria.text: No new third-party dependencies unless justified in the plan and approved (stdlib email/imaplib/zoneinfo preferred); any addition recorded in pyproject with rationale.
acceptance_criteria.verify: git diff -- pyproject.toml uv.lock shows no new deps (uv.lock reverted after test runs), or each added dep has a written justification approved at plan gate.

acceptance_criteria.text: Agent-native: the cycle runs headlessly from the CLI with mocked inbox/SMTP/Investec, machine-readable JSON output and deterministic exit codes; state and audit are assertable in tests.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: invoke entry point with mocks -> JSON summary and expected exit code for ignore/accept/park/cancel/execute paths.

acceptance_criteria.text: Credential scope split (Q9): live mode may use a separate payment-capable credential distinct from the read credential used for ingest/report; read credential never performs writes. Default recommended: separate pay key.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: dry-run builds client with read credential; live uses payment_credentials(); config docs list distinct env vars.

acceptance_criteria.text: Scheduled job spec (proposal, Q4): a GitHub Actions workflow runs the cycle on a cron (e.g. every 15 min) with live mode OFF by default (dry-run), secrets via Actions secrets, concurrency group to prevent overlapping runs, and no live flag set in the file.
acceptance_criteria.verify: Workflow YAML parses (actionlint/yaml load); contains schedule + workflow_dispatch + concurrency; grep shows no live-enable value true; live enablement requires a manually set repo variable/secret.

acceptance_criteria.text: Retention/minimisation: persisted records hold only needed fields (ids as last-3/hash), terminal records are purged after a retention window, and cleanup is covered by tests.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: stored row has no full account number; cleanup removes terminal records older than window and keeps active ones.

acceptance_criteria.text: ARC policy (Q8): handling of ARC-forwarded/mailing-list rewritten messages is explicit and tested; default is reject (do not trust ARC) when direct DKIM/SPF alignment fails.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: message with arc=pass but dkim/spf fail -> rejected under default policy.

acceptance_criteria.text: Operator documentation (README/runbook section) describes trigger grammar, auth requirements, 24h hold, cancel, rollout gates and how to keep live off.
acceptance_criteria.verify: docs file contains each topic heading; reviewer checklist.

out_of_scope: Playwright (or any browser/app-automation) helper that adds beneficiaries or pastes details into the Investec app/online banking: separate future run with its own security review; no automation of banking login/2FA.
Creating beneficiaries via the API (not available; Q1 resolved to notify).
Native Investec scheduled/future-dated payments (not offered by the API; hold is app-side).
Changes to ingest, report, statements, backfill-hashes, backup or beneficiary-matching behaviour and outputs.
Enabling live money movement in this run; live stays off.

open_questions.recommended_default: Pay automatically at execute_after unless cancelled by reply; summary email now + reminder before execution; expire if not executed within window.
From allowlist + Authentication-Results dkim=pass and spf=pass (outer sender); optional shared secret code in body as an extra factor, off by default.
GitHub Actions scheduled workflow (every ~15 min), dry-run by default.

open_questions.q: Exact field order in the Investec mobile app add-beneficiary form (for the unregistered-payee notification).
open_questions.recommended_default: Name, bank, account number, branch code, beneficiary reference, own reference, email, cell; configurable constant, human to confirm against the app.
Unset=0=blocked; human sets values explicitly; suggest low initial values (e.g. R1,000 per payment, R2,000 per day) for the soak.
Do not trust ARC; require direct dkim/spf pass on the outer sender.
Yes: separate pay key used only in live mode; read key for everything else.

rollout_gates: G1 Dry-run soak: run scheduled dry-run only for a minimum period (recommended 14 days / at least 5 real instructions) with audit reviewed and zero unexpected outcomes.
G2 Sandbox test: end-to-end payment exercised against openapisandbox.investec.com (mocked-money) including error bodies (ErrorMessage/AuthorisationRequired) and no-retry behaviour.
G3 Human enables live explicitly: human sets the live flag and pay credential and caps; recorded in audit; never enabled by default or by the loop.
coverage_note: Maps GOAL.md request + Q1 decision and Q2-Q4 proposals to F3-F21; frozen-behaviour and no-secrets constraints are Musts (F2,F22,F23,F24,F25).
confidence: high on guardrails; medium on Investec API write semantics (verify in sandbox, G2).
